about: Morgan & Morgan is a personal injury firm with 17 offices across California, Pennsylvania, New York, Florida, Maryland, Virginia, CO, NC, TN, Connecticut, Georgia and Delaware.

The firm states that it works on a contingency fee, with nothing to pay unless the case is won; the first consultation is free; its intake line is open around the clock. It publishes material in English and Spanish.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 17 listings, counts summed and rating weighted by count

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours and photo count come from the Places API. The owner's own description, the services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way. The API does expose Google's editorial summary, which is a different thing: Google writes those about notable places and has written one for no firm in this directory.

G1.source: the State Bar of California's licensee search, pending review of a licence status
G1.evidence: 32 of 197 named attorneys hold an active California licence. 1 do not (Timothy S. Moran: Resigned). No discipline is recorded against any of them, so this is a licence status rather than a finding of misconduct, and either record may be out of date.

G2.source: the State Bar of California's licensee search, incomplete: an adverse namesake we cannot resolve
G2.evidence: No disciplinary record is held against any of the 33 attorneys we identified. John C. Daniel could not be told apart from 6 namesakes, one of whom is not eligible to practise. Held open.
G2.unresolvable: A namesake carries an adverse status and the register holds no field that would tell the two people apart

G3.evidence: 17 physical locations verified on Google Business Profile. California publishes no business register we are able to query, so the registration itself is not verified here. The state's own business search is the place to check it.

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 197 named attorneys published.
G5.source: Public crawl of the firm's own site

G6.evidence: 42,851 public client reviews across 17 Google listings, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 1996-06-03, so it has been operating for more than a year
G6.source: Google Places API and the domain's registration date over RDAP

operating.source: Domain registration date over RDAP, which is a lower bound on how long the firm has been operating rather than its founding date
